steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the default event type to RFQ and retain whole-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can render.
Add one line item using the named product search and requested quantity.
Populate the remaining required pricing-sheet fields.
Set the delivery location named by the case.
Open the additional pricing-column controls.
Assert that Price Cap is offered as an additional column.
Reopen the additional-column controls after the options assertion.
Add the Price Cap column to the pricing sheet.
Verify that the Price Cap header rendered.
Enter the valid cap value.
Assert that 100 is retained without an error.
Try entering letters into the Price Cap cell.
Assert that the nonnumeric cap is rejected.
Try entering a negative cap.
Assert that the negative cap is rejected with the required message.
Commit a valid schedule so publish validation reaches the price-cap rule.
Add the required participant before attempting publication.
